title: MEMBRANE v0.3.0-rc2 user-validation report
description: One entry per (environment, backend) combination someone actually validated v0.3.0-rc2 against. See docs/rc2-user-validation.md for how to fill this in by hand -- there is no automatic telemetry collection; every entry is a deliberate, manually-authored, manually-submitted report.

environment_id.description: e.g. ENV-01, ENV-01-cpu, ENV-02-vulkan -- must be unique across summary.json. A suffix distinguishes multiple backend reports from the SAME physical/virtual host (same OS/kernel/CPU/RAM), never a different host under the same number.

provenance.description: Always REAL -- this schema has no SIMULATED case. A report that isn't a real run on real hardware does not belong in summary.json at all.

commit.description: Must be the exact commit v0.3.0-rc2 points to (7b94217702cb6b5d170c496660cb3208e01fd714).

os.description: Distro + version, e.g. "Pop!_OS 24.04 LTS". Never a hostname.

cpu.description: CPU model string only, e.g. "AMD Ryzen 5 5600H".

gpu.description: GPU model/vendor string, e.g. "NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650". Omit or empty for a CPU-only report.

runtime.description: One entry per command actually run (--plan-only, a small real generation, etc.).

model.description: Model file NAME only, never a private/local path.

command.description: The exact CLI invocation, with the model path sanitized to just the filename.

outcome.description: EXPECTED_REJECTION covers a documented fail-closed case (e.g. a known-incompatible architecture with compressed KV) -- not a bug.

privacy.description: Self-attestation the reporter sanitized their own report before submitting -- see docs/rc2-user-validation.md's privacy checklist.
